turns.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(COALESCE(ps.brownlow_votes, 0)) DESC) AS rank, p.name AS player, mode() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY t.name) AS team, COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) AS games, SUM(COALESCE(ps.brownlow_votes, 0)) AS brownlow_votes FROM player_stats ps JOIN matches m ON m.id = ps.match_id JOIN players p ON p.id = ps.player_id LEFT JOIN teams t ON t.id = ps.team_id WHERE TRUE AND ps.team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.season >= :season_from AND m.season <= :season_to AND NOT m.is_final GROUP BY p.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT m.id) >= :min_games) x WHERE rank <= :limit ORDER BY rank, player

turns.query: Show Carlton's average score per season from 2015 to 2024
turns.sql: WITH tm AS (SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.season, m.round_name AS round, m.round_number AS round_number, m.is_final AS is_final, m.match_date, m.venue, m.attendance, m.home_team_id AS team_id, m.away_team_id AS opp_id, TRUE AS is_home, m.home_score AS score, m.away_score AS opp_score, m.home_q4_goals AS goals, m.home_q4_behinds AS behinds, m.away_q4_goals AS opp_goals, m.away_q4_behinds AS opp_behinds FROM matches m WHERE (m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND (m.home_score > 0 OR m.away_score > 0)) AND m.home_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.away_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.season >= :season_from AND m.season <= :season_to UNION ALL SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.season, m.round_name AS round, m.round_number AS round_number, m.is_final AS is_final, m.match_date, m.venue, m.attendance, m.away_team_id AS team_id, m.home_team_id AS opp_id, FALSE AS is_home, m.away_score AS score, m.home_score AS opp_score, m.away_q4_goals AS goals, m.away_q4_behinds AS behinds, m.home_q4_goals AS opp_goals, m.home_q4_behinds AS opp_behinds FROM matches m WHERE (m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND (m.home_score > 0 OR m.away_score > 0)) AND m.home_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.away_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.season >= :season_from AND m.season <= :season_to) SELECT tt.name AS team, tm.season, COUNT(*) AS games, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score > tm.opp_score) AS wins, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score < tm.opp_score) AS losses, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score = tm.opp_score) AS draws, SUM(tm.score) AS points_for, SUM(tm.opp_score) AS points_against, SUM(tm.goals) AS goals, SUM(tm.behinds) AS behinds, ROUND(SUM(tm.score) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(tm.opp_score), 0), 1) AS percentage, ROUND(AVG(tm.score), 1) AS avg_score, ROUND(AVG(tm.opp_score), 1) AS avg_conceded FROM tm JOIN teams tt ON tt.id = tm.team_id WHERE tm.team_id = ANY(:team_ids) GROUP BY tt.name, tm.season ORDER BY tm.season, tt.name

turns.sql: WITH tm AS (SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.season, m.round_name AS round, m.round_number AS round_number, m.is_final AS is_final, m.match_date, m.venue, m.attendance, m.home_team_id AS team_id, m.away_team_id AS opp_id, TRUE AS is_home, m.home_score AS score, m.away_score AS opp_score, m.home_q4_goals AS goals, m.home_q4_behinds AS behinds, m.away_q4_goals AS opp_goals, m.away_q4_behinds AS opp_behinds FROM matches m WHERE (m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND (m.home_score > 0 OR m.away_score > 0)) AND m.home_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.away_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.season = :season AND NOT m.is_final UNION ALL SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.season, m.round_name AS round, m.round_number AS round_number, m.is_final AS is_final, m.match_date, m.venue, m.attendance, m.away_team_id AS team_id, m.home_team_id AS opp_id, FALSE AS is_home, m.away_score AS score, m.home_score AS opp_score, m.away_q4_goals AS goals, m.away_q4_behinds AS behinds, m.home_q4_goals AS opp_goals, m.home_q4_behinds AS opp_behinds FROM matches m WHERE (m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND (m.home_score > 0 OR m.away_score > 0)) AND m.home_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.away_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.season = :season AND NOT m.is_final), rec AS (SELECT tm.team_id, COUNT(*) AS played, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score > tm.opp_score) AS wins, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score < tm.opp_score) AS losses, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score = tm.opp_score) AS draws, SUM(tm.score) AS points_for, SUM(tm.opp_score) AS points_against FROM tm GROUP BY tm.team_id), ranked AS (SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wins * 4 + draws * 2 DESC, points_for::numeric / NULLIF(points_against, 0) DESC) AS position, t.name AS team, rec.* , wins * 4 + draws * 2 AS premiership_points, ROUND(points_for * 100.0 / NULLIF(points_against, 0), 1) AS percentage FROM rec JOIN teams t ON t.id = rec.team_id) SELECT position, team, played, wins, losses, draws, premiership_points, points_for, points_against, percentage FROM ranked ORDER BY position

turns.sql: WITH tm AS (SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.season, m.round_name AS round, m.round_number AS round_number, m.is_final AS is_final, m.match_date, m.venue, m.attendance, m.home_team_id AS team_id, m.away_team_id AS opp_id, TRUE AS is_home, m.home_score AS score, m.away_score AS opp_score, m.home_q4_goals AS goals, m.home_q4_behinds AS behinds, m.away_q4_goals AS opp_goals, m.away_q4_behinds AS opp_behinds FROM matches m WHERE (m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND (m.home_score > 0 OR m.away_score > 0)) AND m.home_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.away_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.season = :season AND NOT m.is_final UNION ALL SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.season, m.round_name AS round, m.round_number AS round_number, m.is_final AS is_final, m.match_date, m.venue, m.attendance, m.away_team_id AS team_id, m.home_team_id AS opp_id, FALSE AS is_home, m.away_score AS score, m.home_score AS opp_score, m.away_q4_goals AS goals, m.away_q4_behinds AS behinds, m.home_q4_goals AS opp_goals, m.home_q4_behinds AS opp_behinds FROM matches m WHERE (m.home_score IS NOT NULL AND (m.home_score > 0 OR m.away_score > 0)) AND m.home_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.away_team_id = ANY(:afl_ids) AND m.season = :season AND NOT m.is_final), rec AS (SELECT tm.team_id, COUNT(*) AS played, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score > tm.opp_score) AS wins, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score < tm.opp_score) AS losses, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tm.score = tm.opp_score) AS draws, SUM(tm.score) AS points_for, SUM(tm.opp_score) AS points_against FROM tm GROUP BY tm.team_id), ranked AS (SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wins * 4 + draws * 2 DESC, points_for::numeric / NULLIF(points_against, 0) DESC) AS position, t.name AS team, rec.* , wins * 4 + draws * 2 AS premiership_points, ROUND(points_for * 100.0 / NULLIF(points_against, 0), 1) AS percentage FROM rec JOIN teams t ON t.id = rec.team_id) SELECT position, team, played, wins, losses, draws, premiership_points, points_for, points_against, percentage FROM ranked ORDER BY position
